title: Loans; insurance and guarantees.
bodyText: The authority may procure insurance or guarantees against any default of its loans, in amounts and from insurers or guarantors, as it deems necessary or desirable.
bodyHtml: §206E-122  Loans; insurance and guarantees.  The authority may procure insurance or guarantees against any default of its loans, in amounts and from insurers or guarantors, as it deems necessary or desirable. [L 1982, c 228, pt of §8]
